Nora P (Finance): CloudChannel submitted a dispute — they found duplicate meter lines on our March Azure marketplace invoice. Partner claims $48,920 duplicated.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Need the CSV extract and invoice IDs. If payout not processed we can adjust before settlement. @BillingBot check payout for partner_id CC-9382.

Diego S (Sales): I have the excerpt — meter 33221 appears under sku A and sku A-legacy after our Mar 2 mapping roll. Snippet:
```
line_id,sku,meter_id,usage,charge
L-200111,sku-A,33221,80000,24960.00
L-200112,sku-A-legacy,33221,80000,24960.00
```
Partner requests a credit and a one-line amendment.

BillingBot: Payout scheduled 2026-03-21T14:00:00Z, status pending.

Nora P (Finance): Proposed: issue manual credit $48,920, memo AZ-MP-CREDIT-0326, require signed partner acceptance.

Sofia (Legal): Draft clause ready. I'll send for signature and require a waiver for further claims on this billing period.

Diego S (Sales): Sent amendment; partner signed at 2026-03-21T09:10Z and uploaded to portal.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Posting adjustment now. GL: Debit Revenue 4205-REV-CR / Credit AP-Partner 2202. Reducing payout by $48,920.

Nora P (Finance): Confirmed adjustment posted. Marking ticket closed and scheduling rollback-proof checklist item for SKU mapping rollouts.

BillingBot: Payout updated. No further actions pending.

Diego S (Sales): Partner acknowledged and thanked us for the quick turn. Closing loop.
